  1. 3-Methyl-3-hexanol is a tertiary alcohol (the OH carbon has no H), so: no reaction.

  3. 3-Methyl-2-hexanol is a secondary alcohol. [O] gives the ketone 3-methyl-2-hexanone, CH3COCH(CH3)CH2CH2CH3.

597127.new:
Exercise \(\PageIndex{1}\)

Write the equation for the hydrolysis of each compound.

  1. propionamide (propanamide)
  2. hexanamide
Answer
  1. CH3CH2CONH2 + H2O → CH3CH2COOH + NH3 (propanoic acid and ammonia)
  2. CH3(CH2)4CONH2 + H2O → CH3(CH2)4COOH + NH3 (hexanoic acid and ammonia)

In both, the C(=O)–N bond is the one that breaks. With HCl the ammonia ends up as NH4+; with NaOH the acid ends up as its carboxylate salt.
